findings.summary: The loop gate would print the 'decision-links.toml could not be read' warning a second time, breaking an existing test the plan lists as unchanged.
findings.evidence: governed_check_is_skipped_for_a_resume_at_the_verifier sets up an unreadable list ('not = [toml') and asserts said.iter().filter(|l| l.starts_with("warning: docs/decision-links.toml could not be read")).count() == 1 on the first run (tests.rs:2377-2381). Today only check_and_verify prints it (checks.rs:404-406). Under the plan the shared decision_gate prints it on every loop pass and again in check_and_verify, and dispatch may add a third. The dependents entry for this test says the fallback 'keeps today's behavior' and does not foresee the count change. Fix: Let the loop caller skip quietly when the list cannot be read or parsed: pass a flag to decision_gate, or move the warning into the commit-based caller only. That way the fallback gate prints the warning exactly once. In dispatch, print nothing on a read or parse error, or a line that does not start with that warning. List this test under the gate's dependents with the reason its count stays at 1, and add an assertion that the first run's producer count is 1 (no send-back for an unreadable list).
findings.location: Plan step 3 (decision_gate keeps the warning), step 5 (loop calls unreconciled_in_snapshot), step 6 (dispatch 'at most a warning line'); crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs:2355-2382; checks.rs:403-407

findings.summary: The governing section would sit inside the slice the retry test checks, weakening its D02 and README.md assertions.
findings.evidence: The test takes block = &brief[start..] from '## Findings you must address' to the end of the prompt. The plan adds the governing section after the plan section, so it falls inside that slice and itself names D02 and README.md. block.contains("D02") and contains("README.md") would then pass even if the findings block lost them; only 'decisions not reconciled:' still pins the findings. Fix: When updating the retry test's indexes, cut the slice off at the next '## ' heading or at '## Decisions that govern files you will change', so the D02 and README.md assertions check only the findings block.

findings.summary: A criterion-2 assertion accepts either of two lines, so it does not pin the new gate-specific line.
findings.evidence: 'assert ... the UI has the line 'producer   report still incomplete after the send-back' or the gate-specific line'. Plan step 5 adds a dedicated gate-only line at the budget limit, so an either/or check would pass even if that branch were never taken. Fix: Assert the exact gate-specific line that step 5 adds, and that the 'the verifier will judge it' line is absent.

findings.summary: The reason given for rejecting a change to send_back_text_with_replay overstates its callers.
findings.evidence: Grep shows send_back_text_with_replay called at producer.rs:335 and in send_back.rs tests (336, 342) only, not four callers. Fix: Correct the count. The choice to keep the signature stands.

summary: The approach is sound and follows the request. It runs the gate inside producer_loop on the work tree's change list, so it shares the one send-back with unmet criteria, and it splits unreconciled_decisions into one message builder so the text and GATE_REASON_PREFIX cannot drift. The check_and_verify gate stays as the fallback that produces today's message, and the governing-decisions section is added to the in-memory producer prompt only. I checked in the code that the named seams exist: unreconciled_decisions (checks.rs:375), Snapshot::change_list and Snapshot::blob (snapshot.rs:200, 221), the send-back loop (producer.rs:320-342), and the editing, governed_job and reconciling_edits helpers in tests.rs. The candidate is the base tree plus the change list (candidate.rs:60-108), so the loop's answer matches the later gate. D08 governs only snapshot.rs and candidate.rs, which the plan does not edit. One major gap: the shared builder carries the 'could not be read' warning line, so the loop check (and possibly dispatch) would print it as well as the fallback gate. That breaks governed_check_is_skipped_for_a_resume_at_the_verifier, which asserts the warning appears exactly once, yet the plan lists that test as unchanged. Smaller points: the retry test's findings slice would now take in the new section, and one criterion-2 assertion accepts either of two lines.
